Synopsis:
    South Korea and the US have agreed on a ~$22.3bn South Korean investment to build a 6.3 GW gas-fired power plant in Encinal, Texas, primarily to serve AI data centre power demand. This is the first major deployment under a broader $350bn US investment pledge Seoul made under a bilateral trade deal. Additional projects (large-scale nuclear, Alaska LNG) are under consideration. South Korean authorities have not officially confirmed details.

Q01. Is the content's main message about EU energy, EU commodities, German power market prices, German energy economics?
